mapper.select:
select v.id from bm_product_formula_version v join bm_product_formula f on v.product_formula_id = f.id where v.is_deleted = 0
and f.product_name like concat('%',#{productName},'%')
and f.name like concat('%',#{formulaName},'%')

select v.id,f.product_name,f.product_id,f.product_merge_code,f.name,v.version_no,v.description,v.process_instance_id,v.batch_quantity,v.unit_id from bm_product_formula_version v join bm_product_formula f on v.product_formula_id = f.id where v.is_deleted = 0 and v.id = #{versionId}
